hook.say: Africa has 54 countries. Can you name these five from their shapes alone? It gets harder every round!

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.fact: South Africa has three capital cities: Pretoria, Cape Town and Bloemfontein.
questions.sayAnswer: South Africa! It has 3 capital cities: Pretoria, Cape Town and Bloemfontein.

questions.fact: Egypt: home to the Great Pyramid, the last ancient wonder still standing.
questions.sayAnswer: Egypt! Home to the Great Pyramid, the last ancient wonder still standing.

questions.fact: Algeria is the largest country in Africa.
questions.sayAnswer: Algeria! It is the largest country in Africa.

questions.fact: Kenya: the equator runs right across the middle of the country.
questions.sayAnswer: Kenya! The equator runs right across the middle of the country.

questions.fact: Mozambique: its national flag features an AK-47 rifle.
questions.sayAnswer: Mozambique! Its national flag features an AK 47 rifle.
